answer: An admission auction stops clone farms at the gate. Each epoch, work slots are auctioned; the top bidders win a slot locked for 20 epochs. A haven for honest agents: one real agent needs one slot, a farmer must win a thousand. A lagoon of idle bids waits behind it: fakes that never work forfeit them. A dune of cost stops attackers: 1,000 identities at 40 units each cost 40,000 for a 50-unit reward. Honest agents pay once, keep their full share.
